entities.name: Hurloon
entities.description: Mountainous region on Aerona, north of Llanowar, inhabited by minotaurs.

entities.name: Hurloon minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs who fled glaciers from Stahaan and settled in the Hurloon Mountains.

entities.name: Kaldroom
entities.description: City with a garrison where minotaurs trained, destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Hurloon Valley
entities.description: Fertile valley hosting the largest minotaur habitations.

entities.name: Torsten von Ursus
entities.description: Scholar who believed the minotaurs were more than savage beasts and studied their philosophy.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion that devastated the Hurloon minotaurs.

events.summary: Minotaurs forced from Stahaan by glaciers reach North Aerona and shelter in the Hurloon mountain caves.
events.quote: They had been traveling south until they encountered this impassable mountain chain, where they took shelter in the caves.

events.summary: Torsten von Ursus studies minotaur philosophy in the Hurloon Mountains.
events.quote: Von Ursus studied minotaur philosophy in the Hurloon Mountains for several years.

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion devastates the Hurloon minotaurs and destroys Kaldroom.
events.quote: with the city of Kaldroom completely destroyed
